rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a recognizable medical or psychological syndrome, including named conditions such as Down syndrome.

example.english: This syndrome makes patients very tired.
example.traditional: 呢種綜合症會令病人好攰。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zung1 hap6 zing3 wui5 ling6 beng6 jan4 hou2 gui6
